svg.aria-label: Inside Ferry.perKey: each key has a lane that is ready, busy or idle. One worker takes the first key in the ready line, carries its batch, and puts the key back at the end of the line if more inputs arrived, so a flooded key a cannot starve key b. Key c is idle, so its caller sends its input directly without the worker.
svg.text: maxInFlightBatches = 1 · all state in one TRef[Lanes] · STM
the worker takes the first ready key; a key that still has inputs rejoins the back of the line; idle c skips it
